log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

PROMPT_VERSION = "1"
MAX_TOKENS = 16_000
EFFORT = "medium"
WORKERS = 4
# USD per million tokens (input, output). Unknown models are still run; cost is reported null.
PRICES = {
    "claude-sonnet-5-5": (2.00, 10.00),
    "claude-sonnet-5": (2.00, 10.00),
    "claude-opus-5-5": (4.00, 20.00),
    "claude-haiku-5-5": (0.10, 0.50),
}


class ExtractedPerson(BaseModel):
    full_name: str = Field(description="The person's name exactly as written on the page.")
    title: str = Field(
        description="Their job title copied verbatim from the evidence snippet, without the "
        "company name. Example: 'Chief Financial Officer', 'VP, Engineering', 'Head of Product'."
    )
    employer: str = Field(description="Organization this title is held at, as the page says it.")
    works_at_target_company: bool = Field(
        description="True only if the title is held at the target company (not a customer, "
        "investor, partner, previous employer, or a different organization with a similar name)."
    )
    status: Literal["current", "former", "incoming", "unclear"] = Field(
        description="'former' if the page says they left, were replaced, or uses 'former'/'ex-'/"
        "'previously'; 'incoming' if announced but not started; 'current' only if the page "
        "presents the title as held now (as of the page date)."
    )
    evidence_snippet: str = Field(
        description="A verbatim quote from the page (one or two sentences, under 300 "
        "characters) that contains both the person's name and the title."
    )
    location: str | None = Field(
        description="City/region where the person is based, only if the page states it; else null."
    )
    location_snippet: str | None = Field(
        description="Verbatim quote stating the location; null when location is null."
    )
    bio: str | None = Field(
        description="One verbatim sentence from the page describing their background; else null."
    )


class Extraction(BaseModel):
    page_published_date: str | None = Field(
        description="Publication date shown on the page, as YYYY-MM-DD; null if none is shown."
    )
    published_date_snippet: str | None = Field(
        description="The verbatim text on the page that shows that date; null if none."
    )
    people: list[ExtractedPerson]


SYSTEM = """You extract company leadership from one web page or filing. You read; you never guess.

Rules:
- Target company: {name} (website {domain}). Only include people whose title is held AT the
  target company. Exclude people at other organizations that share the name, customers,
  investors, partners, authors of quoted studies, and people from other companies mentioned in
  the text.
- In scope: C-level officers (Chief ... Officer, CEO, CFO, President, General Counsel),
  founders, Vice Presidents (VP, SVP, EVP), and Heads of a function (Head of X). Skip board-
  only directors, managers, engineers, and other staff.
- Every value must be copied verbatim from the page text: name, title, snippet, location, bio,
  date. Do not translate, expand abbreviations, or fix typos. If something is not stated, use
  null.
- The evidence_snippet must contain both the name and the title, exactly as they appear.
- Mark status 'former' whenever the page says the person left, was replaced, or held the role
  in the past ("former CFO", "previously VP"). A page that announces an appointment presents it
  as current as of the page date.
- If the page lists no in-scope people at the target company, return an empty list.
- Text marked [...] was removed by a filter; only use what you see."""


@dataclass
class ExtractResult:
    doc: RawDocument
    extraction: Extraction | None
    input_tokens: int = 0
    output_tokens: int = 0
    from_cache: bool = False
    error: str = ""


@dataclass
class ExtractStats:
    llm_calls: int = 0
    cached: int = 0
    input_tokens: int = 0  # this run's API calls only
    output_tokens: int = 0
    cached_input_tokens: int = 0  # what the cached responses cost when they were made
    cached_output_tokens: int = 0
    errors: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)

    def cost_usd(self, model: str, include_cached: bool = False) -> float | None:
        price = PRICES.get(model)
        if price is None:
            return None
        tin, tout = self.input_tokens, self.output_tokens
        if include_cached:
            tin, tout = tin + self.cached_input_tokens, tout + self.cached_output_tokens
        return round((tin * price[0] + tout * price[1]) / 1e6, 4)


def _user_prompt(doc: RawDocument, text: str) -> str:
    meta_date = doc.meta.get("published_date") or doc.meta.get("filing_date") or "unknown"
    return (
        f"Source URL: {doc.url}\nPage title: {doc.title}\n"
        f"Publication date from metadata (may be missing): {meta_date}\n\n"
        f"<page>\n{text}\n</page>"
    )


class Extractor:
    def __init__(self, company: Company, model: str, cache_dir: Path, reextract: bool = False):
        self.company = company
        self.model = model
        self.cache_dir = cache_dir
        self.reextract = reextract
        self.system = SYSTEM.format(name=company.name, domain=company.domain)
        self._client: anthropic.Anthropic | None = None

    def _client_lazy(self) -> anthropic.Anthropic:
        if self._client is None:
            self._client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=require_setting("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"))
        return self._client

    def _cache_path(self, doc: RawDocument, text: str) -> Path:
        key = hashlib.sha256(
            "\x00".join([self.model, PROMPT_VERSION, self.system, doc.url, text]).encode("utf-8")
        ).hexdigest()[:24]
        return self.cache_dir / f"{key}.json"

    def extract(self, doc: RawDocument, text: str) -> ExtractResult:
        path = self._cache_path(doc, text)
        if path.exists() and not self.reextract:
            data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            usage = data.get("usage", {})
            return ExtractResult(
                doc,
                Extraction.model_validate(data["extraction"]),
                usage.get("input_tokens", 0),
                usage.get("output_tokens", 0),
                from_cache=True,
            )
        try:
            response = self._client_lazy().messages.parse(
                model=self.model,
                max_tokens=MAX_TOKENS,
                system=self.system,
                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": _user_prompt(doc, text)}],
                output_format=Extraction,
                output_config={"effort": EFFORT},
            )
        except anthropic.AuthenticationError as exc:
            raise RuntimeError("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was rejected (HTTP 401)") from exc
        except anthropic.APIError as exc:
            log.warning("extraction failed for %s: %s", doc.url, exc)
            return ExtractResult(doc, None, error=f"API error: {exc}")
        usage = response.usage
        result = ExtractResult(doc, None, usage.input_tokens, usage.output_tokens)
        if response.stop_reason in ("refusal", "max_tokens") or response.parsed_output is None:
            result.error = f"no structured output (stop_reason={response.stop_reason})"
            return result
        result.extraction = response.parsed_output
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        payload = {
            "url": doc.url,
            "model": self.model,
            "prompt_version": PROMPT_VERSION,
            "usage": {"input_tokens": usage.input_tokens, "output_tokens": usage.output_tokens},
            "extraction": result.extraction.model_dump(),
        }
        path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
        return result

    def extract_all(
        self, jobs: list[tuple[RawDocument, str]]
    ) -> tuple[list[ExtractResult], ExtractStats]:
        stats = ExtractStats()
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=WORKERS) as pool:
            results = list(pool.map(lambda job: self.extract(*job), jobs))
        for r in results:
            if r.from_cache:
                stats.cached += 1
                stats.cached_input_tokens += r.input_tokens
                stats.cached_output_tokens += r.output_tokens
            else:
                stats.llm_calls += 1
                stats.input_tokens += r.input_tokens
                stats.output_tokens += r.output_tokens
            if r.error:
                stats.errors.append({"url": r.doc.url, "error": r.error})
        return results, stats

2	
3	A claim is accepted only if its evidence is literally in the cached document text, the title
4	is literally in the evidence, the title is in scope by the title rules, and the model says the
5	role is held at the target company. Optional fields (location, bio, page date) are dropped,
6	not the whole claim, when their own evidence fails. Every rejection is kept with a reason.

26	def norm_text(text: str) -> str:
27	    """Whitespace, quote and dash differences don't count; everything else must match."""
28	    return " ".join(unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text).translate(_QUOTES).split())

31	def in_text(needle: str, haystack_norm: str, casefold: bool = False) -> bool:
32	    n = norm_text(needle)
33	    if not n:
34	        return False
35	    return n.casefold() in haystack_norm.casefold() if casefold else n in haystack_norm

63	def _iso_date(value: str | None) -> str | None:
64	    if not value:
65	        return None
66	    try:
67	        return date.fromisoformat(value[:10]).isoformat()
68	    except ValueError:
69	        return None

72	REANCHOR_MAX_GAP = 200
73	
74	
75	def _snippet_problem(snippet: str, last_name: str, title: str, doc_norm: str) -> str:
76	    if len(snippet) > MAX_SNIPPET_CHARS:
77	        return "evidence snippet too long"
78	    if not in_text(snippet, doc_norm):
79	        return "evidence snippet not found in the source text"
80	    if last_name not in normalize_name(snippet).split():
81	        return "evidence snippet does not contain the person's last name"
82	    if not in_text(title, norm_text(snippet), casefold=True):
83	        return "title not found in the evidence snippet"
84	    return ""

87	def reanchor(full_name: str, title: str, doc_norm: str) -> str | None:
88	    """Shortest span of the (normalized) source text holding the exact name and the exact
89	    title (case-insensitive) at most REANCHOR_MAX_GAP characters apart. Literal, no LLM."""
90	    name, ttl = norm_text(full_name), norm_text(title).casefold()
91	    if not name or not ttl:
92	        return None
93	    folded = doc_norm.casefold()
94	    best: tuple[int, int] | None = None
95	    for m in re.finditer(re.escape(name), doc_norm):
96	        lo = max(0, m.start() - REANCHOR_MAX_GAP - len(ttl))
97	        hi = min(len(doc_norm), m.end() + REANCHOR_MAX_GAP + len(ttl))
98	        for t in re.finditer(re.escape(ttl), folded[lo:hi]):
99	            ts, te = lo + t.start(), lo + t.end()
100	            gap = max(ts - m.end(), m.start() - te, 0)
101	            if gap > REANCHOR_MAX_GAP:
102	                continue
103	            span = (min(m.start(), ts), max(m.end(), te))
104	            if best is None or span[1] - span[0] < best[1] - best[0]:
105	                best = span
106	    if best is None:
107	        return None
108	    return doc_norm[best[0] : best[1]]
109

111	def page_date(doc: RawDocument, extraction: Extraction, doc_norm: str) -> str | None:
112	    """Filing date (SEC) > page-stated date with verified snippet > search metadata date."""
113	    if doc.source_type == "sec_filing":
114	        return _iso_date(doc.meta.get("filing_date"))
115	    stated = _iso_date(extraction.page_published_date)
116	    snippet = extraction.published_date_snippet
117	    if stated and snippet and in_text(snippet, doc_norm) and stated[:4] in snippet:
118	        return stated
119	    return _iso_date(doc.meta.get("published_date"))

122	def check_person(
123	    doc: RawDocument, p: ExtractedPerson, doc_norm: str, published_at: str | None
124	) -> Claim | Rejection:
125	    def reject(reason: str) -> Rejection:
126	        return Rejection(doc.url, p.full_name, p.title, reason)
127	
128	    tokens = normalize_name(p.full_name).split()
129	    if len(tokens) < 2:
130	        return reject("name is not a full name")
131	    if not p.works_at_target_company:
132	        return reject(f"not at the target company (employer: {p.employer!r})")
133	    if not in_text(p.full_name, doc_norm):
134	        return reject("name not found in the source text")
135	    model_snippet = p.evidence_snippet.strip()
136	    snippet = model_snippet
137	    problem = _snippet_problem(model_snippet, tokens[-1], p.title, doc_norm)
138	    reanchored = False
139	    if problem:
140	        # The model often quotes a sentence but takes the title from a nearby heading. If the
141	        # exact name and title sit close together in the source, quote that span instead.
142	        span = reanchor(p.full_name, p.title, doc_norm)
143	        if span is None:
144	            return reject(problem)
145	        snippet, reanchored = span, True
146	    title_class = classify_title(p.title)
147	    if title_class is None:
148	        return reject("title out of scope (not C-level, founder, VP or Head)")
149	
150	    status = p.status
151	    former_re = rf"\bformer(?:ly)?\b[^.]{{0,40}}{re.escape(p.title)}"
152	    if mentions_former(p.title) or any(
153	        re.search(former_re, norm_text(s), re.I) for s in {snippet, model_snippet}
154	    ):
155	        status = "former"
156	
157	    location = location_snippet = None
158	    if (
159	        p.location
160	        and p.location_snippet
161	        and in_text(p.location_snippet, doc_norm)
162	        and in_text(p.location, norm_text(p.location_snippet), casefold=True)
163	    ):
164	        location, location_snippet = p.location.strip(), p.location_snippet.strip()
165	    bio = None
166	    if p.bio and len(p.bio) <= 1000 and in_text(p.bio, doc_norm):
167	        bio = p.bio.strip()
168	
169	    return Claim(
170	        reanchored=reanchored,
171	        doc=doc,
172	        full_name=p.full_name.strip(),
173	        title=p.title.strip(),
174	        title_class=title_class,
175	        status=status,
176	        evidence_snippet=snippet,
177	        published_at=published_at,
178	        location=location,
179	        location_snippet=location_snippet,
180	        bio=bio,
181	    )
182

184	def validate(doc: RawDocument, extraction: Extraction) -> tuple[list[Claim], list[Rejection]]:
185	    doc_norm = norm_text(doc.text)
186	    published_at = page_date(doc, extraction, doc_norm)
187	    claims: list[Claim] = []
188	    rejections: list[Rejection] = []
189	    for person in extraction.people:
190	        result = check_person(doc, person, doc_norm, published_at)
191	        (claims if isinstance(result, Claim) else rejections).append(result)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
192	    return claims, rejections

"""Full collection run: discover -> pre-filter -> extract (LLM) -> validate -> resolve -> store.

Writes data/<domain>/leadership.db (rebuilt each run, D3) and data/<domain>/leadership.json,
a readable export of the same data. Both are committed; the raw cache is not (D14).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from leadership.config import company_dir, db_path, llm_model
from leadership.pipeline.discover import discover, fetcher_for, normalize_domain, resolve_company
from leadership.pipeline.extract import PROMPT_VERSION, Extractor
from leadership.pipeline.prefilter import select_text
from leadership.pipeline.resolve import Resolution, ResolvedPerson, resolve_claims
from leadership.pipeline.validate import Claim, Rejection, validate
from leadership.sources.base import Company
from leadership.sources.company_site import MAX_PAGES
from leadership.storage.db import connect
from leadership.storage.repository import Repository, RoleIn

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class CollectResult:
    company: Company
    resolution: Resolution
    stats: dict[str, Any]
    db_path: Path
    json_path: Path


def collect(
    url: str,
    *,
    name: str | None = None,
    ticker: str | None = None,
    private: bool = False,
    max_pages: int = MAX_PAGES,
    refresh: bool = False,
    reextract: bool = False,
    today: date | None = None,
) -> CollectResult:
    started = time.monotonic()
    domain = normalize_domain(url)
    with fetcher_for(domain, refresh) as fetcher:
        company = resolve_company(fetcher, url, name, ticker, private)
        found = discover(company, fetcher, max_pages=max_pages)

    jobs, prefilter_skipped = [], []
    for doc in found.documents:
        text, note = select_text(doc)
        if text:
            jobs.append((doc, text))
        else:
            prefilter_skipped.append({"url": doc.url, "reason": note})
    log.info("%d documents, %d sent to the LLM", len(found.documents), len(jobs))

    model = llm_model()
    extractor = Extractor(company, model, company_dir(domain) / "raw" / "_extractions", reextract)
    results, xstats = extractor.extract_all(jobs)

    claims: list[Claim] = []
    rejections: list[Rejection] = []
    for r in results:
        if r.extraction is not None:
            c, rj = validate(r.doc, r.extraction)
            claims += c
            rejections += rj
    resolution = resolve_claims(claims, today=today)

    stats: dict[str, Any] = {
        "model": model,
        "prompt_version": PROMPT_VERSION,
        "discovery": found.stats,
        "documents": len(found.documents),
        "documents_sent_to_llm": len(jobs),
        "prefilter_skipped": len(prefilter_skipped),
        "llm_calls": xstats.llm_calls,
        "llm_cached_responses": xstats.cached,
        "tokens_in": xstats.input_tokens,
        "tokens_out": xstats.output_tokens,
        "cost_usd": xstats.cost_usd(model),
        "cost_usd_including_cached": xstats.cost_usd(model, include_cached=True),
        "extraction_errors": xstats.errors,
        "claims_accepted": len(claims),
        "claims_rejected": len(rejections),
        "rejections": [vars(r) for r in rejections],
        "people_found": len(resolution.people),
        "people_current": sum(p.is_current for p in resolution.people),
        "review": resolution.review,
        "duration_s": 0.0,
    }
    path = db_path(domain)
    _store(path, company, resolution, stats, started)
    json_path = export_json(path, domain)
    return CollectResult(company, resolution, stats, path, json_path)


def _store(
    path: Path, company: Company, resolution: Resolution, stats: dict, started: float
) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    conn = connect(path)
    repo = Repository(conn)
    try:
        with repo.transaction():
            company_id = repo.upsert_company(
                company.name, company.domain, company.is_public, company.ticker
            )
            run_id = repo.start_run(company_id)
            repo.clear_people(company_id)
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM sources WHERE company_id = ?", (company_id,))
            for person in resolution.people:
                _store_person(repo, company_id, person)
            stats["duration_s"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 1)
            repo.finish_run(run_id, stats)
    finally:
        conn.close()


def _source_id(repo: Repository, company_id: int, claim: Claim, cache: dict[str, int]) -> int:
    doc = claim.doc
    if doc.url not in cache:
        cache[doc.url] = repo.add_source(
            company_id, doc.url, doc.source_type, doc.fetched_at, doc.raw_path, claim.published_at
        )
    return cache[doc.url]


def _store_person(repo: Repository, company_id: int, person: ResolvedPerson) -> None:
    sources: dict[str, int] = {}
    best = next(c for c in person.claims if c.full_name == person.full_name)
    person_id = repo.upsert_person(
        company_id,
        person.full_name,
        _source_id(repo, company_id, best, sources),
        best.evidence_snippet,
    )
    for c in person.claims:
        sid = _source_id(repo, company_id, c, sources)
        repo.add_fact(person_id, "full_name", c.full_name, sid, c.evidence_snippet)
        repo.add_fact(
            person_id, "title", c.title, sid, c.evidence_snippet, is_current=c.status != "former"
        )
    if person.location_claim is not None and person.location_claim.location_snippet:
        lc = person.location_claim
        repo.add_fact(
            person_id,
            "location",
            person.location or "",
            _source_id(repo, company_id, lc, sources),
            lc.location_snippet or "",
        )
    if person.bio_claim is not None and person.bio:
        bc = person.bio_claim
        sid = _source_id(repo, company_id, bc, sources)
        repo.add_fact(person_id, "bio", person.bio, sid, person.bio)
    repo.replace_roles(
        person_id,
        [
            RoleIn(r.title, r.function, r.seniority, r.is_current, r.as_of, r.note or None)
            for r in person.roles
        ],
    )
    repo.update_person_resolved(
        person_id,
        full_name=person.full_name,
        confidence=person.confidence,
        location=person.location,
        bio=person.bio,
        profile_url=person.profile_url,
    )


def export_json(path: Path, domain: str) -> Path:
    """Readable, diff-friendly export of the stored data (committed next to the DB)."""
    conn = connect(path)
    try:
        repo = Repository(conn)
        company = repo.get_company(domain) or {}
        people = repo.all_people(domain)
        run = repo.latest_run(domain)
    finally:
        conn.close()
    out = {"company": company, "latest_run": run, "people": people}
    json_path = path.with_name("leadership.json")
    json_path.write_text(
        json.dumps(out, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    return json_path

"""Keyword pre-filter (no LLM): which parts of a document are worth sending to the model.

Pages are long (nav, footers, product copy); leaders appear in a few lines. We keep windows of
lines around leadership keywords and skip documents with no hit at all, so the LLM sees less
text and costs less. The evidence check (validate.py) still runs against the *full* text.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re

from leadership.sources.base import RawDocument

# A line that mentions a leadership role ("Head of Product", "names Jane Doe CFO").
ROLE_LINE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:chief|officer|ceo|cfo|cto|coo|president|vice president|vp|head of|founder|counsel)\b",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
# Publication dates ("March 3, 2025", "2025-03-03"), so the model can report the page date.
DATE_LINE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)[a-z]*\.?\s+\d{1,2},?\s+(?:19|20)\d\d\b"
    r"|\b(?:19|20)\d\d-\d\d-\d\d\b",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
MAX_DATE_LINES = 3
WINDOW_LINES = 3
MAX_CHARS = 24_000  # per document sent to the model; the rest is dropped with a note


def select_text(doc: RawDocument) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """(text for the model, note). Empty text means: no leadership signal, skip the LLM."""
    text = doc.text
    if doc.source_type == "sec_filing":
        span = doc.meta.get("executive_officers_span")
        if span:
            return text[span[0] : span[1]], "SEC executive officers section"
        sig = text.rfind("SIGNATURES")
        if sig >= 0:
            return text[sig : sig + MAX_CHARS], "SEC signatures section"
        return "", "SEC filing without an executive officers or signatures section"

    lines = text.splitlines()
    keep: set[int] = set()
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if ROLE_LINE.search(line):
            keep.update(range(max(0, i - WINDOW_LINES), min(len(lines), i + WINDOW_LINES + 1)))
    if not keep:
        return "", "no leadership keywords"
    dates = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if DATE_LINE.search(line)][:MAX_DATE_LINES]
    keep.update(dates)

    chunks: list[str] = []
    prev = -2
    for i in sorted(keep):
        if i != prev + 1 and chunks:
            chunks.append("[...]")
        chunks.append(lines[i])
        prev = i
    selected = "\n".join(chunks)
    note = f"{len(keep)} of {len(lines)} lines"
    if len(selected) > MAX_CHARS:
        selected = selected[:MAX_CHARS]
        note += f", truncated to {MAX_CHARS} chars"
    return selected, note

1	"""LLM extraction: one structured-output call per pre-filtered document.
2	
3	The model only *reads*: it returns people with verbatim evidence. Everything that decides what
4	is stored (evidence check, title rules, dedupe, currency, confidence) is deterministic code in
5	validate.py and resolve.py. Responses are cached on disk (keyed by model, prompt version and
6	the exact input), so re-running resolution costs nothing; `--reextract` ignores the cache.
7	"""

9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	import hashlib
12	import json

15	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
16	from pathlib import Path

22	from leadership.config import require_setting
23	from leadership.sources.base import Company, RawDocument

25	log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
26	
27	PROMPT_VERSION = "1"
28	MAX_TOKENS = 16_000
29	EFFORT = "medium"
30	WORKERS = 4
31	# USD per million tokens (input, output). Unknown models are still run; cost is reported null.
32	PRICES = {
33	    "claude-sonnet-5-5": (2.00, 10.00),
34	    "claude-sonnet-5": (2.00, 10.00),
35	    "claude-opus-5-5": (4.00, 20.00),
36	    "claude-haiku-5-5": (0.10, 0.50),
37	}
38	
39	
40	class ExtractedPerson(BaseModel):
41	    full_name: str = Field(description="The person's name exactly as written on the page.")
42	    title: str = Field(
43	        description="Their job title copied verbatim from the evidence snippet, without the "
44	        "company name. Example: 'Chief Financial Officer', 'VP, Engineering', 'Head of Product'."
45	    )
46	    employer: str = Field(description="Organization this title is held at, as the page says it.")
47	    works_at_target_company: bool = Field(
48	        description="True only if the title is held at the target company (not a customer, "
49	        "investor, partner, previous employer, or a different organization with a similar name)."
50	    )
51	    status: Literal["current", "former", "incoming", "unclear"] = Field(
52	        description="'former' if the page says they left, were replaced, or uses 'former'/'ex-'/"
53	        "'previously'; 'incoming' if announced but not started; 'current' only if the page "
54	        "presents the title as held now (as of the page date)."
55	    )
56	    evidence_snippet: str = Field(
57	        description="A verbatim quote from the page (one or two sentences, under 300 "
58	        "characters) that contains both the person's name and the title."
59	    )
60	    location: str | None = Field(
61	        description="City/region where the person is based, only if the page states it; else null."
62	    )

64	        description="Verbatim quote stating the location; null when location is null."
65	    )
66	    bio: str | None = Field(
67	        description="One verbatim sentence from the page describing their background; else null."
68	    )

72	    page_published_date: str | None = Field(
73	        description="Publication date shown on the page, as YYYY-MM-DD; null if none is shown."
74	    )
75	    published_date_snippet: str | None = Field(
76	        description="The verbatim text on the page that shows that date; null if none."
77	    )
78	    people: list[ExtractedPerson]
79	
80	
81	SYSTEM = """You extract company leadership from one web page or filing. You read; you never guess.
82	
83	Rules:
84	- Target company: {name} (website {domain}). Only include people whose title is held AT the
85	  target company. Exclude people at other organizations that share the name, customers,
86	  investors, partners, authors of quoted studies, and people from other companies mentioned in
87	  the text.
88	- In scope: C-level officers (Chief ... Officer, CEO, CFO, President, General Counsel),
89	  founders, Vice Presidents (VP, SVP, EVP), and Heads of a function (Head of X). Skip board-
90	  only directors, managers, engineers, and other staff.
91	- Every value must be copied verbatim from the page text: name, title, snippet, location, bio,
92	  date. Do not translate, expand abbreviations, or fix typos. If something is not stated, use
93	  null.
94	- The evidence_snippet must contain both the name and the title, exactly as they appear.
95	- Mark status 'former' whenever the page says the person left, was replaced, or held the role
96	  in the past ("former CFO", "previously VP"). A page that announces an appointment presents it
97	  as current as of the page date.
98	- If the page lists no in-scope people at the target company, return an empty list.
99	- Text marked [...] was removed by a filter; only use what you see."""
100	
101	
102	@dataclass
103	class ExtractResult:
104	    doc: RawDocument
105	    extraction: Extraction | None
106	    input_tokens: int = 0
107	    output_tokens: int = 0
108	    from_cache: bool = False
109	    error: str = ""
110	
111	
112	@dataclass
113	class ExtractStats:
114	    llm_calls: int = 0
115	    cached: int = 0
116	    input_tokens: int = 0  # this run's API calls only
117	    output_tokens: int = 0
118	    cached_input_tokens: int = 0  # what the cached responses cost when they were made
119	    cached_output_tokens: int = 0
120	    errors: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
121	
122	    def cost_usd(self, model: str, include_cached: bool = False) -> float | None:
123	        price = PRICES.get(model)
124	        if price is None:
125	            return None
126	        tin, tout = self.input_tokens, self.output_tokens
127	        if include_cached:
128	            tin, tout = tin + self.cached_input_tokens, tout + self.cached_output_tokens
129	        return round((tin * price[0] + tout * price[1]) / 1e6, 4)
130	
131	
132	def _user_prompt(doc: RawDocument, text: str) -> str:
133	    meta_date = doc.meta.get("published_date") or doc.meta.get("filing_date") or "unknown"
134	    return (
135	        f"Source URL: {doc.url}\nPage title: {doc.title}\n"
136	        f"Publication date from metadata (may be missing): {meta_date}\n\n"
137	        f"<page>\n{text}\n</page>"
138	    )
139	
140	
141	class Extractor:
142	    def __init__(self, company: Company, model: str, cache_dir: Path, reextract: bool = False):
143	        self.company = company
144	        self.model = model
145	        self.cache_dir = cache_dir
146	        self.reextract = reextract
147	        self.system = SYSTEM.format(name=company.name, domain=company.domain)
148	        self._client: anthropic.Anthropic | None = None
149	
150	    def _client_lazy(self) -> anthropic.Anthropic:
151	        if self._client is None:
152	            self._client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=require_setting("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"))
153	        return self._client
154	
155	    def _cache_path(self, doc: RawDocument, text: str) -> Path:
156	        key = hashlib.sha256(
157	            "\x00".join([self.model, PROMPT_VERSION, self.system, doc.url, text]).encode("utf-8")
158	        ).hexdigest()[:24]
159	        return self.cache_dir / f"{key}.json"
160	
161	    def extract(self, doc: RawDocument, text: str) -> ExtractResult:
162	        path = self._cache_path(doc, text)
163	        if path.exists() and not self.reextract:
164	            data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
165	            usage = data.get("usage", {})
166	            return ExtractResult(
167	                doc,
168	                Extraction.model_validate(data["extraction"]),
169	                usage.get("input_tokens", 0),
170	                usage.get("output_tokens", 0),
171	                from_cache=True,
172	            )
173	        try:
174	            response = self._client_lazy().messages.parse(
175	                model=self.model,
176	                max_tokens=MAX_TOKENS,
177	                system=self.system,
178	                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": _user_prompt(doc, text)}],
179	                output_format=Extraction,
180	                output_config={"effort": EFFORT},
181	            )
182	        except anthropic.AuthenticationError as exc:
183	            raise RuntimeError("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was rejected (HTTP 401)") from exc
184	        except anthropic.APIError as exc:
185	            log.warning("extraction failed for %s: %s", doc.url, exc)
186	            return ExtractResult(doc, None, error=f"API error: {exc}")
187	        usage = response.usage
188	        result = ExtractResult(doc, None, usage.input_tokens, usage.output_tokens)
189	        if response.stop_reason in ("refusal", "max_tokens") or response.parsed_output is None:
190	            result.error = f"no structured output (stop_reason={response.stop_reason})"
191	            return result
192	        result.extraction = response.parsed_output
193	        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
194	        payload = {
195	            "url": doc.url,
196	            "model": self.model,
197	            "prompt_version": PROMPT_VERSION,
198	            "usage": {"input_tokens": usage.input_tokens, "output_tokens": usage.output_tokens},
199	            "extraction": result.extraction.model_dump(),
200	        }
201	        path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
202	        return result
203	
204	    def extract_all(
205	        self, jobs: list[tuple[RawDocument, str]]
206	    ) -> tuple[list[ExtractResult], ExtractStats]:
207	        stats = ExtractStats()
208	        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=WORKERS) as pool:
209	            results = list(pool.map(lambda job: self.extract(*job), jobs))
210	        for r in results:
211	            if r.from_cache:
212	                stats.cached += 1
213	                stats.cached_input_tokens += r.input_tokens
214	                stats.cached_output_tokens += r.output_tokens
215	            else:
216	                stats.llm_calls += 1
217	                stats.input_tokens += r.input_tokens
218	                stats.output_tokens += r.output_tokens
219	            if r.error:
220	                stats.errors.append({"url": r.doc.url, "error": r.error})
221	        return results, stats
222

1	"""Deterministic checks on what the model extracted (no LLM).
2	
3	A claim is accepted only if its evidence is literally in the cached document text, the title
4	is literally in the evidence, the title is in scope by the title rules, and the model says the
5	role is held at the target company. Optional fields (location, bio, page date) are dropped,
6	not the whole claim, when their own evidence fails. Every rejection is kept with a reason.
7	"""
8	
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	import re
12	import unicodedata
13	from dataclasses import dataclass
14	from datetime import date
15	
16	from leadership.models import normalize_name
17	from leadership.pipeline.extract import ExtractedPerson, Extraction
18	from leadership.pipeline.titles import TitleClass, classify_title, mentions_former
19	from leadership.sources.base import RawDocument
20	
21	MAX_SNIPPET_CHARS = 500
22	
23	_QUOTES = str.maketrans({"’": "'", "‘": "'", "“": '"', "”": '"', "–": "-", "—": "-", "\xa0": " "})
24	
25	
26	def norm_text(text: str) -> str:
27	    """Whitespace, quote and dash differences don't count; everything else must match."""
28	    return " ".join(unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text).translate(_QUOTES).split())
29	
30	
31	def in_text(needle: str, haystack_norm: str, casefold: bool = False) -> bool:
32	    n = norm_text(needle)
33	    if not n:
34	        return False
35	    return n.casefold() in haystack_norm.casefold() if casefold else n in haystack_norm
36	
37	
38	@dataclass(frozen=True)
39	class Claim:
40	    """One accepted (person, title) statement from one document."""
41	
42	    doc: RawDocument
43	    full_name: str
44	    title: str
45	    title_class: TitleClass
46	    status: str  # current | former | incoming | unclear
47	    evidence_snippet: str
48	    published_at: str | None  # YYYY-MM-DD, verified on the page or from source metadata
49	    location: str | None = None
50	    location_snippet: str | None = None
51	    bio: str | None = None
52	    reanchored: bool = False  # evidence span taken from the source, not the model's quote
53	
54	
55	@dataclass(frozen=True)
56	class Rejection:
57	    url: str
58	    full_name: str
59	    title: str
60	    reason: str
61	
62	
63	def _iso_date(value: str | None) -> str | None:
64	    if not value:
65	        return None
66	    try:
67	        return date.fromisoformat(value[:10]).isoformat()
68	    except ValueError:
69	        return None
70	
71	
72	REANCHOR_MAX_GAP = 200
73	
74	
75	def _snippet_problem(snippet: str, last_name: str, title: str, doc_norm: str) -> str:
76	    if len(snippet) > MAX_SNIPPET_CHARS:
77	        return "evidence snippet too long"
78	    if not in_text(snippet, doc_norm):
79	        return "evidence snippet not found in the source text"
80	    if last_name not in normalize_name(snippet).split():
81	        return "evidence snippet does not contain the person's last name"
82	    if not in_text(title, norm_text(snippet), casefold=True):
83	        return "title not found in the evidence snippet"
84	    return ""
85	
86	
87	def reanchor(full_name: str, title: str, doc_norm: str) -> str | None:
88	    """Shortest span of the (normalized) source text holding the exact name and the exact
89	    title (case-insensitive) at most REANCHOR_MAX_GAP characters apart. Literal, no LLM."""
90	    name, ttl = norm_text(full_name), norm_text(title).casefold()
91	    if not name or not ttl:
92	        return None
93	    folded = doc_norm.casefold()
94	    best: tuple[int, int] | None = None
95	    for m in re.finditer(re.escape(name), doc_norm):
96	        lo = max(0, m.start() - REANCHOR_MAX_GAP - len(ttl))
97	        hi = min(len(doc_norm), m.end() + REANCHOR_MAX_GAP + len(ttl))
98	        for t in re.finditer(re.escape(ttl), folded[lo:hi]):
99	            ts, te = lo + t.start(), lo + t.end()
100	            gap = max(ts - m.end(), m.start() - te, 0)
101	            if gap > REANCHOR_MAX_GAP:
102	                continue
103	            span = (min(m.start(), ts), max(m.end(), te))
104	            if best is None or span[1] - span[0] < best[1] - best[0]:
105	                best = span
106	    if best is None:
107	        return None
108	    return doc_norm[best[0] : best[1]]
109	
110	
111	def page_date(doc: RawDocument, extraction: Extraction, doc_norm: str) -> str | None:
112	    """Filing date (SEC) > page-stated date with verified snippet > search metadata date."""
113	    if doc.source_type == "sec_filing":
114	        return _iso_date(doc.meta.get("filing_date"))
115	    stated = _iso_date(extraction.page_published_date)
116	    snippet = extraction.published_date_snippet
117	    if stated and snippet and in_text(snippet, doc_norm) and stated[:4] in snippet:
118	        return stated
119	    return _iso_date(doc.meta.get("published_date"))
120	
121	
122	def check_person(
123	    doc: RawDocument, p: ExtractedPerson, doc_norm: str, published_at: str | None
124	) -> Claim | Rejection:
125	    def reject(reason: str) -> Rejection:
126	        return Rejection(doc.url, p.full_name, p.title, reason)
127	
128	    tokens = normalize_name(p.full_name).split()
129	    if len(tokens) < 2:
130	        return reject("name is not a full name")
131	    if not p.works_at_target_company:
132	        return reject(f"not at the target company (employer: {p.employer!r})")
133	    if not in_text(p.full_name, doc_norm):
134	        return reject("name not found in the source text")
135	    model_snippet = p.evidence_snippet.strip()
136	    snippet = model_snippet
137	    problem = _snippet_problem(model_snippet, tokens[-1], p.title, doc_norm)
138	    reanchored = False
139	    if problem:
140	        # The model often quotes a sentence but takes the title from a nearby heading. If the
141	        # exact name and title sit close together in the source, quote that span instead.
142	        span = reanchor(p.full_name, p.title, doc_norm)
143	        if span is None:
144	            return reject(problem)
145	        snippet, reanchored = span, True
146	    title_class = classify_title(p.title)
147	    if title_class is None:
148	        return reject("title out of scope (not C-level, founder, VP or Head)")
149	
150	    status = p.status
151	    former_re = rf"\bformer(?:ly)?\b[^.]{{0,40}}{re.escape(p.title)}"
152	    if mentions_former(p.title) or any(
153	        re.search(former_re, norm_text(s), re.I) for s in {snippet, model_snippet}
154	    ):
155	        status = "former"
156	
157	    location = location_snippet = None
158	    if (
159	        p.location
160	        and p.location_snippet
161	        and in_text(p.location_snippet, doc_norm)
162	        and in_text(p.location, norm_text(p.location_snippet), casefold=True)
163	    ):
164	        location, location_snippet = p.location.strip(), p.location_snippet.strip()
165	    bio = None
166	    if p.bio and len(p.bio) <= 1000 and in_text(p.bio, doc_norm):
167	        bio = p.bio.strip()
168	
169	    return Claim(
170	        reanchored=reanchored,
171	        doc=doc,
172	        full_name=p.full_name.strip(),
173	        title=p.title.strip(),
174	        title_class=title_class,
175	        status=status,
176	        evidence_snippet=snippet,
177	        published_at=published_at,
178	        location=location,
179	        location_snippet=location_snippet,
180	        bio=bio,
181	    )
182	
183	
184	def validate(doc: RawDocument, extraction: Extraction) -> tuple[list[Claim], list[Rejection]]:
185	    doc_norm = norm_text(doc.text)
186	    published_at = page_date(doc, extraction, doc_norm)
187	    claims: list[Claim] = []
188	    rejections: list[Rejection] = []
189	    for person in extraction.people:
190	        result = check_person(doc, person, doc_norm, published_at)
191	        (claims if isinstance(result, Claim) else rejections).append(result)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
192	    return claims, rejections
193

1	"""Full collection run: discover -> pre-filter -> extract (LLM) -> validate -> resolve -> store.
2	
3	Writes data/<domain>/leadership.db (rebuilt each run, D3) and data/<domain>/leadership.json,
4	a readable export of the same data. Both are committed; the raw cache is not (D14).
5	"""
6	
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	import json
10	import logging
11	import time
12	from dataclasses import dataclass
13	from datetime import date
14	from pathlib import Path
15	from typing import Any
16	
17	from leadership.config import company_dir, db_path, llm_model
18	from leadership.pipeline.discover import discover, fetcher_for, normalize_domain, resolve_company
19	from leadership.pipeline.extract import PROMPT_VERSION, Extractor
20	from leadership.pipeline.prefilter import select_text
21	from leadership.pipeline.resolve import Resolution, ResolvedPerson, resolve_claims
22	from leadership.pipeline.validate import Claim, Rejection, validate
23	from leadership.sources.base import Company
24	from leadership.sources.company_site import MAX_PAGES
25	from leadership.storage.db import connect
26	from leadership.storage.repository import Repository, RoleIn
27	
28	log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
29	
30	
31	@dataclass
32	class CollectResult:
33	    company: Company
34	    resolution: Resolution
35	    stats: dict[str, Any]
36	    db_path: Path
37	    json_path: Path
38	
39	
40	def collect(
41	    url: str,
42	    *,
43	    name: str | None = None,
44	    ticker: str | None = None,
45	    private: bool = False,
46	    max_pages: int = MAX_PAGES,
47	    refresh: bool = False,
48	    reextract: bool = False,
49	    today: date | None = None,
50	) -> CollectResult:
51	    started = time.monotonic()
52	    domain = normalize_domain(url)
53	    with fetcher_for(domain, refresh) as fetcher:
54	        company = resolve_company(fetcher, url, name, ticker, private)
55	        found = discover(company, fetcher, max_pages=max_pages)
56	
57	    jobs, prefilter_skipped = [], []
58	    for doc in found.documents:
59	        text, note = select_text(doc)
60	        if text:
61	            jobs.append((doc, text))
62	        else:
63	            prefilter_skipped.append({"url": doc.url, "reason": note})
64	    log.info("%d documents, %d sent to the LLM", len(found.documents), len(jobs))
65	
66	    model = llm_model()
67	    extractor = Extractor(company, model, company_dir(domain) / "raw" / "_extractions", reextract)
68	    results, xstats = extractor.extract_all(jobs)
69	
70	    claims: list[Claim] = []
71	    rejections: list[Rejection] = []
72	    for r in results:
73	        if r.extraction is not None:
74	            c, rj = validate(r.doc, r.extraction)
75	            claims += c
76	            rejections += rj
77	    resolution = resolve_claims(claims, today=today)
78	
79	    stats: dict[str, Any] = {
80	        "model": model,
81	        "prompt_version": PROMPT_VERSION,
82	        "discovery": found.stats,
83	        "documents": len(found.documents),
84	        "documents_sent_to_llm": len(jobs),
85	        "prefilter_skipped": len(prefilter_skipped),
86	        "llm_calls": xstats.llm_calls,
87	        "llm_cached_responses": xstats.cached,
88	        "tokens_in": xstats.input_tokens,
89	        "tokens_out": xstats.output_tokens,
90	        "cost_usd": xstats.cost_usd(model),
91	        "cost_usd_including_cached": xstats.cost_usd(model, include_cached=True),
92	        "extraction_errors": xstats.errors,
93	        "claims_accepted": len(claims),
94	        "claims_rejected": len(rejections),
95	        "rejections": [vars(r) for r in rejections],
96	        "people_found": len(resolution.people),
97	        "people_current": sum(p.is_current for p in resolution.people),
98	        "review": resolution.review,
99	        "duration_s": 0.0,
100	    }
101	    path = db_path(domain)
102	    _store(path, company, resolution, stats, started)
103	    json_path = export_json(path, domain)
104	    return CollectResult(company, resolution, stats, path, json_path)
105	
106	
107	def _store(
108	    path: Path, company: Company, resolution: Resolution, stats: dict, started: float
109	) -> None:
110	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
111	    conn = connect(path)
112	    repo = Repository(conn)
113	    try:
114	        with repo.transaction():
115	            company_id = repo.upsert_company(
116	                company.name, company.domain, company.is_public, company.ticker
117	            )
118	            run_id = repo.start_run(company_id)
119	            repo.clear_people(company_id)
120	            conn.execute("DELETE FROM sources WHERE company_id = ?", (company_id,))
121	            for person in resolution.people:
122	                _store_person(repo, company_id, person)
123	            stats["duration_s"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 1)
124	            repo.finish_run(run_id, stats)
125	    finally:
126	        conn.close()
127	
128	
129	def _source_id(repo: Repository, company_id: int, claim: Claim, cache: dict[str, int]) -> int:
130	    doc = claim.doc
131	    if doc.url not in cache:
132	        cache[doc.url] = repo.add_source(
133	            company_id, doc.url, doc.source_type, doc.fetched_at, doc.raw_path, claim.published_at
134	        )
135	    return cache[doc.url]
136	
137	
138	def _store_person(repo: Repository, company_id: int, person: ResolvedPerson) -> None:
139	    sources: dict[str, int] = {}
140	    best = next(c for c in person.claims if c.full_name == person.full_name)
141	    person_id = repo.upsert_person(
142	        company_id,
143	        person.full_name,
144	        _source_id(repo, company_id, best, sources),
145	        best.evidence_snippet,
146	    )
147	    for c in person.claims:
148	        sid = _source_id(repo, company_id, c, sources)
149	        repo.add_fact(person_id, "full_name", c.full_name, sid, c.evidence_snippet)
150	        repo.add_fact(
151	            person_id, "title", c.title, sid, c.evidence_snippet, is_current=c.status != "former"
152	        )
153	    if person.location_claim is not None and person.location_claim.location_snippet:
154	        lc = person.location_claim
155	        repo.add_fact(
156	            person_id,
157	            "location",
158	            person.location or "",
159	            _source_id(repo, company_id, lc, sources),
160	            lc.location_snippet or "",
161	        )
162	    if person.bio_claim is not None and person.bio:
163	        bc = person.bio_claim
164	        sid = _source_id(repo, company_id, bc, sources)
165	        repo.add_fact(person_id, "bio", person.bio, sid, person.bio)
166	    repo.replace_roles(
167	        person_id,
168	        [
169	            RoleIn(r.title, r.function, r.seniority, r.is_current, r.as_of, r.note or None)
170	            for r in person.roles
171	        ],
172	    )
173	    repo.update_person_resolved(
174	        person_id,
175	        full_name=person.full_name,
176	        confidence=person.confidence,
177	        location=person.location,
178	        bio=person.bio,
179	        profile_url=person.profile_url,
180	    )
181	
182	
183	def export_json(path: Path, domain: str) -> Path:
184	    """Readable, diff-friendly export of the stored data (committed next to the DB)."""
185	    conn = connect(path)
186	    try:
187	        repo = Repository(conn)
188	        company = repo.get_company(domain) or {}
189	        people = repo.all_people(domain)
190	        run = repo.latest_run(domain)
191	    finally:
192	        conn.close()
193	    out = {"company": company, "latest_run": run, "people": people}
194	    json_path = path.with_name("leadership.json")
195	    json_path.write_text(
196	        json.dumps(out, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
197	    )
198	    return json_path

1	"""Deterministic title rules (no LLM): is a title in scope, and what seniority/function is it.
2	
3	In scope: C-level (incl. President and General Counsel, D4), founders, VPs, and Heads.
4	Out of scope: board-only roles, plain "Director", managers, individual contributors.
5	"""
6	
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	import re
10	from dataclasses import dataclass
11	
12	_C_ACRONYMS = {
13	    "ceo": "other",
14	    "cfo": "finance",
15	    "cto": "engineering",
16	    "coo": "operations",
17	    "cmo": "marketing",
18	    "cpo": "product",
19	    "ciso": "security",
20	    "cso": "security",
21	    "cro": "sales",
22	    "clo": "legal",
23	    "chro": "people",
24	    "cio": "engineering",
25	    "cdo": "data",
26	    "cco": "legal",
27	}
28	
29	# Checked in order; the first function whose pattern matches the title wins. Sales comes
30	# before engineering so "Head of Technology Partnerships" is sales, not engineering.
31	_FUNCTION_PATTERNS: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] = (
32	    ("security", r"secur|trust|\bciso\b"),
33	    ("legal", r"legal|counsel|complian|regulat|corporate affairs|policy|privacy"),
34	    ("finance", r"financ|account|treasur|controller|investor relations|tax\b|\bfp&a\b"),
35	    ("people", r"\bpeople\b|human resources|\bhr\b|talent|recruit|culture|workplace"),
36	    ("data", r"\bdata\b|analytics|machine learning|\bai\b|artificial intelligence"),
37	    ("design", r"design|\bux\b|creative"),
38	    ("product", r"product"),
39	    ("marketing", r"marketing|brand|communications|\bpr\b|growth|content|community"),
40	    (
41	        "sales",
42	        r"sales|revenue|business development|partnership|commercial|go-to-market|\bgtm\b"
43	        r"|customer success|account",
44	    ),
45	    (
46	        "engineering",
47	        r"engineer|technolog|technical|information|infrastructure|platform|architect|\bit\b",
48	    ),
49	    ("operations", r"operat|customer|support|brokerage|strategy|business"),
50	)
51	
52	_BOARD_ONLY = re.compile(
53	    r"^(?:independent |lead independent |non-executive )?(?:board )?"
54	    r"(?:director|board member|member of the board|chair(?:man|woman|person)?"
55	    r"(?: of the board)?)$"
56	)
57	_FORMER = re.compile(r"\b(?:former(?:ly)?|ex-|previously|retired|outgoing)\b")
58	
59	
60	@dataclass(frozen=True)
61	class TitleClass:
62	    seniority: str  # c_level | vp | head | founder
63	    function: str
64	    also_founder: bool = False  # e.g. "Co-founder & CEO": one c_level role plus a founder role
65	
66	
67	def _clean(title: str) -> str:
68	    t = title.lower().replace("’", "'").replace("–", "-").replace("—", "-")
69	    t = " ".join(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9&,'/\- ]", " ", t).split())
70	    # Plurals from shared titles: "Co-Founders and Co-CEOs" -> "co-founder and co-ceo"
71	    return re.sub(r"\b(founder|ceo|cfo|cto|coo|officer)s\b", r"\1", t)
72	
73	
74	def function_for(title: str) -> str:
75	    t = _clean(title)

1	"""Keyword pre-filter (no LLM): which parts of a document are worth sending to the model.
2	
3	Pages are long (nav, footers, product copy); leaders appear in a few lines. We keep windows of
4	lines around leadership keywords and skip documents with no hit at all, so the LLM sees less
5	text and costs less. The evidence check (validate.py) still runs against the *full* text.
6	"""
7	
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	import re
11	
12	from leadership.sources.base import RawDocument
13	
14	# A line that mentions a leadership role ("Head of Product", "names Jane Doe CFO").
15	ROLE_LINE = re.compile(
16	    r"\b(?:chief|officer|ceo|cfo|cto|coo|president|vice president|vp|head of|founder|counsel)\b",
17	    re.IGNORECASE,
18	)
19	# Publication dates ("March 3, 2025", "2025-03-03"), so the model can report the page date.
20	DATE_LINE = re.compile(
21	    r"\b(?:jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)[a-z]*\.?\s+\d{1,2},?\s+(?:19|20)\d\d\b"
22	    r"|\b(?:19|20)\d\d-\d\d-\d\d\b",
23	    re.IGNORECASE,
24	)
25	MAX_DATE_LINES = 3
26	WINDOW_LINES = 3
27	MAX_CHARS = 24_000  # per document sent to the model; the rest is dropped with a note
28	
29	
30	def select_text(doc: RawDocument) -> tuple[str, str]:
31	    """(text for the model, note). Empty text means: no leadership signal, skip the LLM."""
32	    text = doc.text
33	    if doc.source_type == "sec_filing":
34	        span = doc.meta.get("executive_officers_span")
35	        if span:
36	            return text[span[0] : span[1]], "SEC executive officers section"
37	        sig = text.rfind("SIGNATURES")
38	        if sig >= 0:
39	            return text[sig : sig + MAX_CHARS], "SEC signatures section"
40	        return "", "SEC filing without an executive officers or signatures section"
41	
42	    lines = text.splitlines()
43	    keep: set[int] = set()
44	    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
45	        if ROLE_LINE.search(line):
46	            keep.update(range(max(0, i - WINDOW_LINES), min(len(lines), i + WINDOW_LINES + 1)))
47	    if not keep:
48	        return "", "no leadership keywords"
49	    dates = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if DATE_LINE.search(line)][:MAX_DATE_LINES]
50	    keep.update(dates)
51	
52	    chunks: list[str] = []
53	    prev = -2
54	    for i in sorted(keep):
55	        if i != prev + 1 and chunks:
56	            chunks.append("[...]")
57	        chunks.append(lines[i])
58	        prev = i
59	    selected = "\n".join(chunks)
60	    note = f"{len(keep)} of {len(lines)} lines"
61	    if len(selected) > MAX_CHARS:
62	        selected = selected[:MAX_CHARS]
63	        note += f", truncated to {MAX_CHARS} chars"
64	    return selected, note

"""Offline tests for Phase 3: title rules, evidence checks, currency and confidence rules.

No LLM here: the model's structured output is constructed by hand (`Extraction`), which is
exactly the shape the real call returns. The runtime path always calls the real API.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

import pytest

from leadership.pipeline.extract import ExtractedPerson, Extraction
from leadership.pipeline.prefilter import select_text
from leadership.pipeline.resolve import resolve_claims
from leadership.pipeline.titles import classify_title
from leadership.pipeline.validate import Claim, Rejection, validate
from leadership.sources.base import RawDocument

TODAY = date(2026, 11, 24)

PROXY_TEXT = """Executive Officers
The names of our current executive officers are set forth in the table below:
Name
Age
Position
Vladimir Tenev
39
Chair and Chief Executive Officer
Shiv Verma
41
Chief Financial Officer
Our named executive officers for 2025 were:
Vladimir Tenev, Chair and Chief Executive Officer;
Jason Warnick, former Chief Financial Officer.
As previously disclosed, Mr. Warnick ceased to serve as Chief Financial Officer effective
February 6, 2026."""

NEWS_TEXT = """Newsroom
March 1, 2021
Robinhood names Jason Warnick Chief Financial Officer.
Robinhood names Gretchen Howard Chief Operating Officer.
Robinhood names Vlad Tenev Chief Executive Officer."""


def doc(url: str, text: str, source_type: str = "company_site", **meta) -> RawDocument:
    return RawDocument(url, source_type, "t", text, "2026-11-24T00:00:00+00:00", "x.txt", meta)


def person(name, title, snippet, status="current", works=True, **kw) -> ExtractedPerson:
    return ExtractedPerson(
        full_name=name,
        title=title,
        employer="Robinhood",
        works_at_target_company=works,
        status=status,
        evidence_snippet=snippet,
        location=kw.get("location"),
        location_snippet=kw.get("location_snippet"),
        bio=kw.get("bio"),
    )


def proxy_claims() -> list[Claim]:
    d = doc(
        "https://sec.test/def14a",
        PROXY_TEXT,
        "sec_filing",
        form="DEF 14A",
        filing_date="2026-04-22",
    )
    ex = Extraction(
        page_published_date=None,
        published_date_snippet=None,
        people=[
            person("Vladimir Tenev", "Chair and Chief Executive Officer",
                   "Vladimir Tenev 39 Chair and Chief Executive Officer"),
            person("Shiv Verma", "Chief Financial Officer",
                   "Shiv Verma 41 Chief Financial Officer"),
            # The model is asked for status; even if it says 'current', the snippet says former.
            person("Jason Warnick", "Chief Financial Officer",
                   "Jason Warnick, former Chief Financial Officer.", status="current"),
        ],
    )  # fmt: skip
    claims, rejections = validate(d, ex)
    assert not rejections
    return claims


def news_claims() -> list[Claim]:
    d = doc("https://robinhood.test/news/2021", NEWS_TEXT)
    ex = Extraction(
        page_published_date="2021-03-01",
        published_date_snippet="March 1, 2021",
        people=[
            person("Jason Warnick", "Chief Financial Officer",
                   "Robinhood names Jason Warnick Chief Financial Officer."),
            person("Gretchen Howard", "Chief Operating Officer",
                   "Robinhood names Gretchen Howard Chief Operating Officer."),
            person("Vlad Tenev", "Chief Executive Officer",
                   "Robinhood names Vlad Tenev Chief Executive Officer."),
        ],
    )  # fmt: skip
    claims, rejections = validate(d, ex)
    assert not rejections
    return claims


def by_name(resolution, name):
    return next(p for p in resolution.people if p.full_name == name)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- title rules


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("title", "seniority", "function"),
    [
        ("Chair and Chief Executive Officer", "c_level", "other"),
        ("Chief Legal, Compliance, and Corporate Affairs Officer", "c_level", "legal"),
        ("Chief Brokerage Officer", "c_level", "operations"),
        ("CFO", "c_level", "finance"),
        ("President", "c_level", "other"),
        ("General Counsel", "c_level", "legal"),
        ("SVP, Engineering", "vp", "engineering"),
        ("Vice President of Product", "vp", "product"),
        ("Head of Product", "head", "product"),
        ("Head of People", "head", "people"),
        ("Co-founder", "founder", "other"),
    ],
)
def test_classify_title(title, seniority, function):
    tc = classify_title(title)
    assert tc is not None and (tc.seniority, tc.function) == (seniority, function)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "title", ["Independent Director", "Chairman", "Director of Engineering", "Software Engineer",
              "Chief of Staff", "Product Manager"],
)  # fmt: skip
def test_out_of_scope_titles(title):
    assert classify_title(title) is None


def test_founder_and_ceo_gets_both_roles():
    tc = classify_title("CEO & Founder")
    assert tc is not None and tc.seniority == "c_level" and tc.also_founder


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- evidence checks


def test_snippet_must_be_literal_in_source():
    d = doc("https://x.test/a", "Jane Doe is our Chief Technology Officer.\nMore text.")
    ex = Extraction(page_published_date=None, published_date_snippet=None, people=[
        person("Jane Doe", "Chief Technology Officer", "Jane Doe is our Chief Technology Officer."),
        person("Jane Doe", "VP of Engineering", "Jane Doe leads engineering as VP."),
        person("Jane Doe", "CTO", "Jane Doe is our Chief Technology Officer."),
        person("John Roe", "Chief Executive Officer", "John Roe, CEO of Ramp", works=False),
    ])  # fmt: skip
    claims, rejections = validate(d, ex)
    assert len(claims) == 1
    reasons = [r.reason for r in rejections]
    assert "evidence snippet not found in the source text" in reasons
    assert "title not found in the evidence snippet" in reasons
    assert any(r.startswith("not at the target company") for r in reasons)


def test_whitespace_and_curly_quotes_do_not_break_the_literal_check():
    d = doc("https://x.test/b", "Jane  Doe\nHead of Product at Acme’s HQ")
    ex = Extraction(page_published_date=None, published_date_snippet=None, people=[
        person("Jane Doe", "Head of Product", "Jane Doe Head of Product at Acme's HQ"),
    ])  # fmt: skip
    claims, _ = validate(d, ex)
    assert len(claims) == 1


def test_unverified_location_and_date_are_dropped_not_invented():
    d = doc("https://x.test/c", "Jane Doe, VP of Sales, joined last week.")
    ex = Extraction(
        page_published_date="2025-01-01",
        published_date_snippet="January 1, 2025",
        people=[
            person(
                "Jane Doe",
                "VP of Sales",
                "Jane Doe, VP of Sales, joined",
                location="Denver",
                location_snippet="based in Denver",
            )
        ],
    )
    (claim,), _ = validate(d, ex)
    assert claim.location is None and claim.published_at is None


def test_single_first_name_is_rejected():
    d = doc("https://x.test/d", "Thanks to John, our Head of Sales.")
    ex = Extraction(
        page_published_date=None,
        published_date_snippet=None,
        people=[person("John", "Head of Sales", "John, our Head of Sales")],
    )
    claims, (rej,) = validate(d, ex)
    assert not claims and isinstance(rej, Rejection) and "full name" in rej.reason


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- currency rules


def test_warnick_former_cfo_in_proxy_is_never_current():
    """The proxy says 'former Chief Financial Officer'; an old newsroom post says CFO."""
    res = resolve_claims(proxy_claims() + news_claims(), today=TODAY)
    warnick = by_name(res, "Jason Warnick")
    assert not warnick.is_current
    assert all(not r.is_current for r in warnick.roles)
    verma = by_name(res, "Shiv Verma")
    assert verma.is_current and verma.confidence == "high"


def test_warnick_from_proxy_alone_is_not_current():
    res = resolve_claims(proxy_claims(), today=TODAY)
    assert not by_name(res, "Jason Warnick").is_current


def test_older_newsroom_c_level_not_in_proxy_is_not_current():
    res = resolve_claims(proxy_claims() + news_claims(), today=TODAY)
    howard = by_name(res, "Gretchen Howard")
    assert not howard.is_current
    assert "proxy" in howard.roles[0].note
    assert any(e["person"] == "Gretchen Howard" for e in res.review["superseded_by_proxy"])


def test_undated_c_level_not_in_proxy_stays_current_and_is_listed():
    """The proxy lists Section 16 officers only; an undated IR page listing a Chief People
    Officer can't be shown to be older than the proxy."""
    d = doc("https://investors.robinhood.test/leadership", "Connie Schan\nChief People Officer",
            "search")  # fmt: skip
    ex = Extraction(page_published_date=None, published_date_snippet=None,
                    people=[person("Connie Schan", "Chief People Officer",
                                   "Connie Schan Chief People Officer")])  # fmt: skip
    claims, _ = validate(d, ex)
    res = resolve_claims(proxy_claims() + claims, today=TODAY)
    assert by_name(res, "Connie Schan").is_current
    assert res.review["c_level_not_in_proxy_undated"][0]["person"] == "Connie Schan"


def test_newsroom_c_level_newer_than_proxy_stays_current():
    d = doc(
        "https://robinhood.test/news/2026",
        "June 2, 2026\nRobinhood names Ann Lee Chief Marketing Officer.",
    )
    ex = Extraction(
        page_published_date="2026-06-02",
        published_date_snippet="June 2, 2026",
        people=[
            person(
                "Ann Lee",
                "Chief Marketing Officer",
                "Robinhood names Ann Lee Chief Marketing Officer.",
            )
        ],
    )
    claims, _ = validate(d, ex)
    res = resolve_claims(proxy_claims() + claims, today=TODAY)
    assert by_name(res, "Ann Lee").is_current


def test_vlad_and_vladimir_merge_and_stay_current():
    res = resolve_claims(proxy_claims() + news_claims(), today=TODAY)
    tenev = [p for p in res.people if p.full_name.endswith("Tenev")]
    assert len(tenev) == 1 and tenev[0].is_current
    assert {"names": ["Vlad Tenev", "Vladimir Tenev"]} in res.review["merged_by_nickname_rule"]


def test_uncorroborated_single_source_older_than_18_months_is_low_and_listed():
    d = doc("https://news.test/2023", "May 1, 2023\nAcme hires Bo Park as VP of Data.", "search")
    ex = Extraction(
        page_published_date="2023-05-01",
        published_date_snippet="May 1, 2023",
        people=[person("Bo Park", "VP of Data", "Acme hires Bo Park as VP of Data.")],
    )
    claims, _ = validate(d, ex)
    res = resolve_claims(claims, today=TODAY)
    park = by_name(res, "Bo Park")
    assert park.is_current and park.confidence == "low"
    assert res.review["stale_single_source"][0]["person"] == "Bo Park"

    d = doc("https://acme.test/team", "Our team\nBo Park\nHead of Design")
    ex = Extraction(
        page_published_date=None,
        published_date_snippet=None,
        people=[person("Bo Park", "Head of Design", "Bo Park Head of Design")],
    )
    claims, _ = validate(d, ex)
    assert by_name(resolve_claims(claims, today=TODAY), "Bo Park").confidence == "medium"

    d = doc("https://investors.acme.test/m/bo", "Bo Park, VP of Finance", "search",
            direct_fetch="blocked: investors.acme.test/robots.txt returned HTTP 403")  # fmt: skip

def test_prefilter_keeps_role_lines_and_skips_pages_without_them():
    page = doc("https://x.test/p", "\n".join(["nav"] * 50 + ["Jane Doe", "Head of Product"]))
    text, _ = select_text(page)
    assert "Head of Product" in text and text.count("nav") <= 3
    assert select_text(doc("https://x.test/q", "pricing\nfeatures\ncontact us"))[0] == ""


def test_prefilter_uses_the_sec_executive_officers_span():
    text = "x" * 100 + PROXY_TEXT + "y" * 100
    d = doc(
        "https://sec.test/p",
        text,
        "sec_filing",
        executive_officers_span=[100, 100 + len(PROXY_TEXT)],
    )
    assert select_text(d)[0] == PROXY_TEXT


def test_evidence_is_reanchored_to_the_literal_heading_when_the_quote_rewords_the_title():
    text = (
        "Chris Koegel\nVice President, Corporate Finance & Investor Relations\n"
        "Chris Koegel is the Vice President of Corporate Finance and Investor Relations."
    )
    d = doc("https://investors.x.test/m/ck", text, "search")
    ex = Extraction(page_published_date=None, published_date_snippet=None, people=[
        person("Chris Koegel", "Vice President, Corporate Finance & Investor Relations",
               "Chris Koegel is the Vice President of Corporate Finance and Investor Relations."),
    ])  # fmt: skip
    (claim,), rejections = validate(d, ex)
    assert not rejections and claim.reanchored
    assert claim.evidence_snippet == (
        "Chris Koegel Vice President, Corporate Finance & Investor Relations"
    )


def test_reanchor_handles_table_cells_and_refuses_distant_matches():
    text = (
        "| Date: | May 8, 2026 |\n| | | | Name: Shiv Verma |\n"
        "| | | | Title: Chief Financial Officer |"
    )
    d = doc("https://sec.test/8k", text, "search")
    ex = Extraction(page_published_date=None, published_date_snippet=None, people=[
        person("Shiv Verma", "Chief Financial Officer",
               "Name: Shiv Verma | | | | Title: Chief Financial Officer"),
    ])  # fmt: skip
    (claim,), _ = validate(d, ex)
    assert claim.reanchored and "Shiv Verma" in claim.evidence_snippet

    far = doc("https://x.test/far", "Jane Doe wrote this.\n" + "filler " * 80 + "\nHead of Sales")
    ex = Extraction(
        page_published_date=None,
        published_date_snippet=None,
        people=[person("Jane Doe", "Head of Sales", "Jane Doe, Head of Sales")],
    )
    claims, (rej,) = validate(far, ex)
    assert not claims and rej.reason == "evidence snippet not found in the source text"


def test_promotion_supersedes_older_title_in_same_function():
    vp = doc("https://rh.test/2018", "November 29, 2018\nGretchen Howard is joining us as "
             "Vice President of Operations.")  # fmt: skip
    coo = doc("https://rh.test/2019", "June 24, 2019\nGretchen Howard has been elevated to "
              "Chief Operating Officer.")  # fmt: skip
    claims = []
    for d, title, date_text, iso in [
        (vp, "Vice President of Operations", "November 29, 2018", "2018-11-29"),
        (coo, "Chief Operating Officer", "June 24, 2019", "2019-06-24"),
    ]:
        snippet = d.text.split("\n", 1)[1]
        ex = Extraction(page_published_date=iso, published_date_snippet=date_text,
                        people=[person("Gretchen Howard", title, snippet)])  # fmt: skip
        claims += validate(d, ex)[0]
    res = resolve_claims(claims, today=TODAY)
    roles = {r.title: r for r in by_name(res, "Gretchen Howard").roles}
    assert not roles["Vice President of Operations"].is_current
    assert "superseded" in roles["Vice President of Operations"].note
    assert roles["Chief Operating Officer"].is_current  # no proxy in this test

## Phase review: Phase 3 (extract + validate + resolve + collect)
**Verdict:** PASS WITH FIXES
Tests: 100 passed / 0 failed · Ruff: clean (`ruff check` all passed; `ruff format --check` 32 files already formatted)

I ran `uv run leadership collect robinhood.com --ticker HOOD` from cache: 0 LLM calls, $0.0 (the cached responses originally cost $0.7138). 25 of 35 people are current, 134 claims accepted and 7 rejected. Apart from run ids and timestamps the output was the same as the previous JSON. Both JSON exports are clean: every fact has a URL, evidence snippet and `retrieved_at`, and none contains U+FFFD. Every person sourced from investors.robinhood.com is in `from_blocked_host`. `data/*/raw/` (including `_extractions/`) is gitignored. No secrets turned up and no runtime mocks. `LLM_MODEL` defaults to `claude-sonnet-5-5` (config.py:14).

### Blockers
None.

### Should fix
- **Subsidiary names drive the function and create fake seat conflicts.** [src/leadership/pipeline/titles.py:34, 102]
  - Evidence: `function_for` runs over the whole title, so the `financ` pattern matches "Robinhood Financial". In data/robinhood.com/leadership.json, Walter Koller gets two current C-level roles: "Vice President and Chief Operating Officer" (operations) and "Vice President and Chief Operating Officer, Robinhood Financial" (**finance**).
  - This breaks D16's "one role per (seniority, function)" rule and adds a false CFO seat conflict: `seat_conflicts.finance = [Shiv Verma, Walter Koller]`.
  - Fix: strip the company and subsidiary qualifier (the text after the last ", " or " of <Company>…") before matching the function.
- **Subsidiary and "VP and Chief X" titles count as C-level.** [titles.py:96-109]
  - Evidence (all current c_level): "President of Robinhood UK and General Manager of Bitstamp UK" (Jordan Sinclair), "Vice President, Credit Cards and Chief Credit Officer" (Ravi Mehta), "Vice President and Chief Information Security Officer" (Evan McHenry), and Koller above.
  - This inflates "how many C-level" answers. The `c_level_not_in_proxy_undated` list does show them, but the title rule decides it silently.
  - Fix: classify a title containing a VP token, or a President title qualified by a subsidiary, as `vp`. Alternatively, keep c_level but record the rule in D16 and test it.
- **URL variants of one article count as corroboration.** [src/leadership/pipeline/resolve.py:279 `urls = {c.doc.url for c in claims}`, also line 328 `single = ...`]
  - Evidence: Kelly Zigaitis and Norm Ashkenas are `high` from `.../chief-compliance-officers` and `.../chief-compliance-officers/`, which is the same post with and without a trailing slash.
  - Jeff Pinner has the same newsroom article twice: `robinhood.com/newsroom/...` (company_site) and `www.robinhood.com/us/en/newsroom/...` (search).
  - This inflates confidence and `source_count`, and it lets a role escape the 18-month single-source rule.
  - Fix: count corroboration on a canonical URL (lowercase host, no `www.`, no trailing slash, no locale prefix).
- **A role retired by the proxy shows the wrong title and date.** [resolve.py:324 `supporting = current if is_current else (former or claims)`]
  - Evidence: Baiju Bhatt's role is shown as `'chief creative officer'`, `as_of: None`, note "not listed in the 2026-04-22 proxy, which is newer than this claim".
  - That title and the missing date come from the undated Wikipedia claim (status former). The claims the proxy actually retired are the dated company_site posts (2021-2024, "Chief Creative Officer and Co-Founder").
  - Fix: when the proxy rule fires, set `supporting = current`.
- **Re-anchored evidence is not surfaced for hand-checking.** [src/leadership/pipeline/validate.py:52, 145]
  - Evidence: `Claim.reanchored` is set but never read anywhere (grep finds only validate.py).
  - Re-anchoring pairs a name with the nearest literal title within 200 characters, so on team grids it can attach a neighbour's title. D18 says this cut rejections from 22 to 7, yet reviewers can't see which facts were affected.
  - Fix: add a `review["reanchored"]` list (person, title, URL) for VALIDATION.md.
- **Cost figures depend on unsourced prices.** [src/leadership/pipeline/extract.py:32-37]
  - Evidence: `PRICES = {"claude-sonnet-5-5": (2.00, 10.00), ...}` has no source or date.
  - The "cost per run" in stats_json and the README rests on these numbers.
  - Fix: cite the pricing page and the date checked, in a comment or in D17.

### Nits
- [extract.py:152] `anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=...)` relies on the SDK's default timeout and retries. Set `timeout=` and `max_retries=` explicitly so the limits are visible.
- [validate.py:151] `former_re = rf"\bformer(?:ly)?\b[^.]{{0,40}}{re.escape(p.title)}"` can fire on phrasing like "former SEC Commissioner, as Chief Legal Officer". It is fine in the current data, but it has no negative test.
- [src/leadership/storage/repository.py:274-275] The `clear_people` docstring still calls `sources` "the durable record", but D19 and collect.py:120 now delete sources every run.
- "Stephanie Guild, CFA" is stored and displayed with the credential suffix. normalize_name drops "cfa", but `full_name` keeps it.
- `extracted_at` and `retrieved_at` are rewritten on every re-resolve, so the committed JSON changes about 1.3k lines with no change in content.

### D16 reading (as asked)
Limiting the proxy rule to dated claims is a faithful reading. The requirement concerns "a newsroom appointment older than the proxy", and an undated page can't be shown to be older. Undated C-level roles stay current, but they are listed (8 for Robinhood) rather than silently trusted. The required Warnick case holds:
- In the data he is `is_current False` (proxy snippet "Jason Warnick, former Chief Financial Officer.").
- Tests cover him both with and without the 2021 newsroom post (tests/test_extract_resolve.py:211, 221).

### What's good
- The evidence gate is strict and literal. Location, bio and date each need their own verified snippet or are dropped to NULL, and all 7 rejections are kept with reasons in stats_json.
- The currency logic catches real changes. Jeff Pinner is correctly not current because a 2026-05-08 8-K ("would be separating from his position") is newer than his 2026-04-22 proxy listing. Gretchen Howard's 2018 VP to 2019 COO promotion is handled.
- Cost is logged honestly: the cost of this run and the cost of the cached responses are reported separately (`cost_usd` 0.0 vs `cost_usd_including_cached` 0.7138), and extraction errors are recorded instead of swallowed.

Files reviewed: C:\Users\pangi\RAG Assignment\src\leadership\pipeline\{collect,extract,prefilter,titles,validate,resolve}.py, C:\Users\pangi\RAG Assignment\src\leadership\storage\{repository.py,schema.sql}, C:\Users\pangi\RAG Assignment\src\leadership\sources\fetch.py, C:\Users\pangi\RAG Assignment\src\leadership\cli.py, C:\Users\pangi\RAG Assignment\tests\test_extract_resolve.py, C:\Users\pangi\RAG Assignment\data\robinhood.com\leadership.json, C:\Users\pangi\RAG Assignment\data\meetcampfire.com\leadership.json.
